speaker: EKENE
text: Compact actual to Lodestar. Before I hand you a war, you get one quiet morning. This is Saltglass Cove — my range, my rules. That Skarn under you is patched, fueled, and safetied. Do exactly as I say, and by sundown we will both pretend you were born in that cockpit.

speaker: RELAY
text: Range is green, the boards are patched, and I have rebuilt those barricades twice this week already. Be gentle with my handiwork, Lodestar.

speaker: CAIRN
text: Training safeties engaged. Hull integrity simulated.

speaker: EKENE
text: Feet first, guns later. W and S run the throttle, A and D steer the legs. Thread the barricade lane and put yourself on NAV ALPHA. Scrape my paint and you repaint it.

speaker: EKENE
text: Throttle, Lodestar. The machine will not walk itself.

speaker: EKENE
text: Clean lane. Maybe there is a pilot in there after all.

speaker: EKENE
text: Torso and legs are two different animals. Legs walk the line — the torso does the aiming. The mouse steers your reticle, and C squares you back up. Walk on, and keep that reticle pinned to the drill drone. Five seconds. Do not blink.

speaker: EKENE
text: Keep walking. Aim with the mouse — let your hips and your hands do different jobs.

speaker: EKENE
text: Held it. Hips point the walk, hands point the guns. Never confuse the two in a fight.

speaker: EKENE
text: Three dead hulks out on the flat. Your sensors see them long before your eyes do. R cycles targets, T grabs whatever is under your reticle, and E picks the piece of them you want to hurt. Lock all three and read their damage boards.

speaker: CAIRN
text: Target lock confirmed.

speaker: EKENE
text: Good. That readout tells you where a machine is already bleeding. Shoot machines where they are bleeding.

speaker: EKENE
text: Boards up! Group one is your cannon, group two the laser, group three the rockets. Drop all four boards — and use at least two different weapon groups doing it.

speaker: RELAY
text: I spent a whole afternoon on those silhouettes, so — no, actually, shred them. That is the job.

speaker: EKENE
text: Different groups, Lodestar. One, two, three — the laser bills you in heat, the cannon and rockets bill you in ammunition.

speaker: EKENE
text: Four for four. Ammunition runs out and heat always comes back — know which bill you are paying before you pull the trigger.

speaker: EKENE
text: Now the lesson that kills the careless. Cycle every trigger — one, two, three, again and again — until the heat runs past the warning line. When the klaxon sounds, flush coolant — F — and feel the machine come back to you.

speaker: CAIRN
text: Coolant flush engaged.

speaker: EKENE
text: Again — but this time ride it all the way down into shutdown, and hold O to override the restart. It costs the machine. One day it will buy your life.

speaker: EKENE
text: Heat is a debt, Lodestar. Flush early. Override never — unless the alternative is dying.

speaker: EKENE
text: The derelict at NAV CHARLIE owes nobody anything. Press E and pick its right arm off the damage board. Take the arm — then punch out the center torso.

speaker: EKENE
text: See what it is without an arm? Strip the weapon before you strip the life. Legs work too — a legged machine is salvage, and salvage wins this war.

speaker: EKENE
text: Jump jets. Hold SPACE, watch the fuel, and mind the heat they pour on. Put yourself up on the shelf at NAV BRAVO.

speaker: EKENE
text: High ground is a weapon that points both ways — up there you see everything, and everything sees you. Use it. Do not live on it.

speaker: CAIRN
text: Training safeties disengaged. Live fire.

speaker: EKENE
text: Last lesson. Relay is taking the range Gabbro up — live rounds, both directions. Fight it like you mean it, and stand down when it yields.

speaker: RELAY
text: Try not to embarrass me in front of the commander, Lodestar. Actually — do. I will dine on the story either way.

speaker: RELAY
text: Yield! Yield — powering down. That is... yeah. That is a pilot.

speaker: EKENE
text: Enough. You will do, Lodestar. Get some sleep — tomorrow night we steal you a real one. Welcome to the Compact.

speaker: EKENE
text: We will drill that one again another day. Moving on.

speaker: CAIRN
text: Stage reset.

speaker: CAIRN
text: Training complete. All boards green.
